deviations.description: Added a ROUTE_MANIFEST_ROOT environment-variable override to manifest-routing-lib.sh (default unchanged: '.claude'), rather than leaving the four hardcoded '.claude/extensions/*/manifest.json' globs as-is
deviations.reason: The plan instructs 'source the Phase 1 library rather than re-deriving the ladder, so the lint validates what the router actually does' -- but the library as written in Phase 1 hardcodes the DEPLOYED tree path, and the lint must validate the SOURCE STORE (agent-system/extensions/**) pre-deploy, matching lint-agent-contracts.sh's own convention. A configurable root (defaulting to the unchanged '.claude') lets both the live router and the lint/test share one ladder implementation without duplicating it, which is the literal point of the instruction. Verified via full baseline-diff replay that the default-unset behavior is byte-for-byte unchanged from before this edit.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added ROUTE_MANIFEST_ROOT override to manifest-routing-lib.sh, default unchanged)*
